sec-head.h2: What does an OpenAI API developer do?

p: An OpenAI API developer builds production-grade integrations connecting OpenAI models to your existing systems. This includes API authentication and rate-limit handling, prompt engineering for specific use cases, streaming response architecture, error handling and fallback logic, and monitoring for cost and latency. A freelance OpenAI API developer delivers a deployed, integrated system with a proven track record of reliable connections, not a sandbox demo.
